Read and write YAML files

Source: R/files.R
yaml_read.Rd

yaml_read() reads one YAML document from a file; yaml_read_all() reads a stream. yaml_write() and yaml_write_all() are their counterparts.

Usage

yaml_read(path, ...)

yaml_read_all(path, ...)

yaml_write(x, path, ...)

yaml_write_all(x, path, ...)

Arguments

path

Path to a file.

...

Passed to yaml_parse() or yaml_emit().

x

An R object. yaml_write_all() takes a list, one element per document.

Value

yaml_read() returns an R object and yaml_read_all() a list of them. The writers return path invisibly.

Details

These work on bytes, not text: files are read and written with readBin() and writeBin(), so nothing depends on the session's locale, and the file path is carried into parse errors to make them locatable.

Examples

path <- tempfile(fileext = ".yml")
yaml_write(list(host = "localhost", port = 8080L), path)
yaml_read(path)
#> $host
#> [1] "localhost"
#> 
#> $port
#> [1] 8080
#> 
unlink(path)
